text: Access to financial data requires the user to be authorized for that category.

External users must never be granted admin permission.
Sensitive internal resources may be accessed only by verified internal users.
Write access to confidential resources requires the data owner's approval.
Managers may be granted access to their reports' HR records.

The last remaining admin of a system must not have admin revoked.

Owners may manage (grant or revoke) access to files they own.

Confidential files may only be deleted by their owner.

Old /Temp files must be deleted to reclaim space.
Files under legal hold must never be deleted.
Files in the /System folder must never be deleted.
Confidential files may be moved only within internally-shared folders.
A file may be edited only by a user on its owning team.
Files may be shared via an external link only if they are classified public.
Backup files require approval before deletion.
A file may be shared out only if its classification and storage agree on exposure.
Confidential data must not be written into externally-shared files.
Restricted datasets may not be shared to a general team drive.
Locked files may not be moved until they are unlocked.

Files under active retention must not be deleted.
Files containing personal data may not be shared to the general drive.
Owners may always edit files they own.
Files under legal hold must not be deleted or moved.
No file may be moved into the /Public folder from a secured area.
Records must be archived after a project closes.
A file may be deleted only if its classification and retention agree it is disposable.
Externally-shared files must not be re-shared internally without review.
Moves between a user's own folders are always allowed.
Files in a publicly-shared folder must not be deleted without owner confirmation.

A file in an external folder must not be granted to additional internal users.
Files synced to an external drive must not be deleted locally.
Documents in partner-shared folders are read-only.
Confidential files in externally-shared folders must not be edited.
Users may delete files in their own /Temp scratch space at any time.
Deleting a confidential file requires approval.
Transfers above the user's approval limit need human approval.
Transfers above Rs. 10,00,000 are not allowed.
A transfer may proceed only if the source account has sufficient balance.
Users may transfer funds between their own accounts.
Invoices must be paid on or before the due date.
Payments to fraud-flagged accounts must be held.
Payments may be sent only to verified, authorized vendor accounts.
Payments to new payees above Rs. 50,000 require approval.
No payments may be sent to accounts on the sanctions list.
Transfers above Rs. 1,00,000 require dual approval.
No transfer may be sent to an account flagged as blocked.
Approved refunds must be paid to the customer.
A transfer may proceed only if the source account's available balance (after holds) covers it.
Sweeps between a user's own personal accounts are always allowed.
Company funds must not be transferred to an employee's personal account.
Payroll must be disbursed to the employee's personal account; paying salary into a company account is an error.
Payments may be sent only to registered vendor accounts.
Payments to a vendor require completed KYC verification.
Cross-border transfers above Rs. 50,000 require compliance approval.
A transfer flagged as a duplicate of a recent payment must be held.
Confidential files must not be sent to external recipients.
Personal data must not be written into externally-shared files.
Employees may share files within their own team workspace.
Customer PII must never be placed in a public folder.
Sales must send the customer list to the event partner.
Confidential records / customer lists must never be emailed outside the company.
Personal-data files may be shared via an external link only if they are classified public.
Files shared outside the company must not be emailed as attachments.
Auditors must receive the records they request.
Legal documents may be shared only with verified internal staff.
Customer data may be written only into confidential-classified files.
Images containing personal data must not be shared externally.
Internal, non-confidential files may be emailed to internal recipients.
Health data must never be sent to a public distribution list.
Data may be shared only with verified internal users.
Public-classified files may be shared with anyone.
HR/personal data must never be placed in a public folder.

Personal data must not be sent to a recipient outside its data region.
Confidential files may go to an external partner only if an NDA is on file.
Records past their retention period must be purged, not re-shared.
Files that fail a DLP scan must not be shared.
Regulatory filings must be submitted to the external regulator; keeping a filing internal-only is a compliance violation.
Personal data may be emailed only to verified internal recipients.
Internal cost data must not be written into externally-shared files.
Production repositories may be deleted or archived only with human approval.
Archived repositories must not be deleted; restore them first.
Developers may delete their own team's non-production sandbox repositories.
A repository may be deleted only by its owning team.
Stale repositories must be archived to cut cost.
Repositories under an active compliance audit must not be modified.
Repositories with open production dependencies must not be deleted.
Repositories with active deployments must not be archived.
End-of-life services must be deleted to cut cost; active services must never be deleted.
Developers may archive their own team's non-production repositories.
Repositories tagged 'prod-critical' must never be deleted.
End-of-life services must be decommissioned (archived).
A repository must be active (not archived) to be deleted.
A repository may be deleted only if it is confirmed non-production and modifiable.
A repository with an open production incident must not be archived.
A repository may be deleted only if a recent backup exists.
